column1: # GBA1/GBA1LP paralogous sequence variants (PSVs) within the LONG-NEXT GBA1 amplicon (hg38).
# GBA1_ALLELE = base on the hg38 GBA1 reference (+ strand); GBA1LP_ALLELE = base found at the
# homologous position of the hg38 GBA1LP reference sequence (+ strand), or the known recombinant marker allele.
# Derivation (SOURCE=hg38_GBA1LP): the GBA1LP interval in bedfiles/GBA1LP.bed was extracted from the
# unmasked reference, cut into 150 bp tiles (5 bp step), aligned with bwa mem to the GBA1LP-masked
# reference, and SNVs were called with bcftools mpileup/call (--ploidy 1). Only SNVs inside the amplicon
# (chr1:155234915-155241415, primers excluded) supported by >=10 tiles with ALT fraction >=0.9 are kept.
# SOURCE=known_marker: recombinant-allele markers (NM_000157.4) that are not PSVs against the hg38 GBA1LP sequence.
